Exactly SIX UNIQUE whole UPRIGHT FOOTLESS ink blob cartoon-claymation monsters,3columns2rows,landscape1536x1024 transparent PNG. No previous generated sheet as style parent. Charcoal-black thick goo with deep violet sheen,round asymmetric splat lobes,few round ink droplets,short goo hands,huge expressive face directly in continuous body. Complete upright camera-facing FOOTLESS ink blobs,no human torso,legs,feet,cropped bust,stone human statues or robot/animal bodies. Rich soft modeled plasticine,fine fingerprints,wood/metal/fabric/clay prop craft,not angular stone/noisy patches or glossy generic Pixar people. Exactly TWO female-read via subtle lids/lashes/headgear,not human anatomy. WHITE/IVORY sclera,RED iris,BLACK pupil;thick fully colored violet lids,eyes unobscured. Dark ink-colored lips,no pink human lipstick. Teeth only from INSIDE upper gum down into mouth,never on outer lower lip;closed mouths toothless. Six own strong silhouettes,gazes,mouths,poses/emotions,not six angry grins. A few simple readable coherent props,not clutter or dysfunctional giant contraptions. Costumes small collars/panels only,whole goo body dominant. No extra living creatures/characters/puppets. Philosophers free surreal archetypal echoes,not scientific diagrams or exact historical likenesses.
FAMILY: Full Class Roster, deck inspiration platos_dungeon_raid_v05.
TOP LEFT — Duelist Einerseits, maennlich-read. Dialectic Duelist: tall slender bent pear ink blob,small plum duelling cap,tiny cream ruff,ONE short silver rapier held diagonally down beside body and little parrying spoon in other hand. Gleeful asymmetrical open grin with TWO upper teeth,one brow raised. Personality: Never meets a counterargument he cannot take personally.
TOP MIDDLE — Rangerin Bildspur, weiblich-read. Allegory Ranger: broad round top-heavy ink blob,small moss-green traveller hood BACK from eyes,two lashes,ONE compact bow and rolled map with only THREE simple trail pictograms. Huge unequal eyes following map,tiny open toothless oval mouth. Personality: Can track a meaning much further than its author intended.
TOP RIGHT — Logikmönch Folgerichtig, maennlich-read. Logic Monk: low broad square rounded splat,small cream monk cowl folded BACK not hiding eyes,tiny brown collar,ONE thick loop of THREE large wooden counting beads and little smooth ivory square tile. Heavy uneven eyelids,closed toothless severe straight mouth. Personality: Accepts the conclusion reluctantly and the premises under protest.
BOTTOM LEFT — Rhetorikhexe Wohlklang, weiblich-read. Rhetoric Warlock: tall hooked ink blob,small berry pointed hat swept back,two lashes,tiny teal collar,ONE ornate brass horn with short carved handle and little sealed scroll. Enormous charming crooked open smile with THREE upper teeth,one eye almost winking. Personality: Makes the last word sound like everyone's favourite first thought.
BOTTOM MIDDLE — Ethikdruide Abwägung, maennlich-read. Ethics Druid: round lopsided broad ink splat,small woven leaf crown ABOVE eyes,tiny moss shoulder patch,ONE little wooden balance with ONE acorn in each pan,no animals. Raised worried brows,small nervous closed toothless crooked smile. Personality: Can feel the weight of both sides long after the meeting ends.
BOTTOM RIGHT — Mythenwecker Nachleben, maennlich-read. Myth Necromancer: tall broad-based tapered ink blob,small charcoal hood BACK from exposed face with one ivory crescent bead,tiny plum collar,ONE old closed storybook chained to short key handle and little carved wooden skull CHARM,inanimate,no corpse or extra creature. One suspicious high brow,heavy lid,closed dark ink toothless wavy pout. Personality: Brings old stories back because nobody has finished arguing with them.
